CPRS Web Mock

CPRS 1.33.112.1's main window and its ten chart tabs, laid out control for control from CPRS's Delphi source. Choose a tab, open a menu, or select a control to see where it sits and which windows its code can open, then open those windows, layer by layer. Nothing here reaches VistA: lists show their column headers and no rows, and text VistA supplies at run time is left out.

Select a control, a tab or a menu command to see its place and what it opens.

Open a window from the side panel, by double-clicking a control that can open only one, or with a menu command that opens only one. Esc or ✕ closes the top window; double-clicking a window's cancel button closes it too. Right-click a control that has a context menu to open it. Commands shown only to programmers, and controls hidden at design, are left out, as a clinician sees them.

Drawn from the data of the CPRS Navigation Design reference (vista-forge docs repo, proposals/cprs-navigation/design-reference), measured from the source of CPRS 1.33.112.1.
